svg.title: Phone, 390px: the team panel full screen, one-column rows, a one-row footer, This team at the end of the body, a short viewport, Add a team in one column
svg.desc: Four 390 by 844 phone screens. 1: New team full screen, Copy a template, agent rows on two lines, footer with Cancel and Create team in one row. 2: an open row scrolled, every field in one column, the prompt wrapping inside its box. 3: Edit team after a failed save, the error summary wrapping; at the end of the body, under the heading This team, Save as a template with its reason and Remove team; the footer holds only Cancel and Save changes. 4: Add a team full screen, cards in one column, their buttons side by side or wrapping. 5: 320 by 256 (400% zoom): the header and footer scroll with the body. Nothing scrolls sideways. Light theme, existing tokens.
svg.text: Under 640px the panel and the Add a team dialog go full screen and everything is one column. 16px gutters; targets 44px. Words from copy.md.
1 · NEW TEAM, TOP OF THE BODY
Shown on the Agents page and on New task.
Fills every agent from the template; change
Outlines and drafts the piece for…

Line one: chevron, dot, name, badges; the remove
button, 44px, at the end. Line two: the coordinator
radio and its label (a 44px tall hit area), then the
description cut short. Names never truncate before
Under 640px the footer holds only Cancel and the
primary action, side by side, one 44px row (about
70px with padding). The body is its own scroller
between header and footer, so a focused field or a
summary link's target never lands under either: no
Name, Description, Prompt, Colour, Its work counts as,
Engine, Model, Policy profile. Inputs 44px tall. The
prompt wraps (about 36 characters) with a narrower
gutter; it grows to 24 lines and then scrolls, so the
page is never stuck inside it. Colour swatches grow
4 · The summary wraps; nothing is cut
Each link may take two lines; it is still one link.
The panel title truncates only past 24 characters
("Edit the Product Research…"); the close button
5 · This team: the rarer actions, at the end
Edit only, under 640px. After + Add agent, an h3
"This team" holds Save as a template (off, with
"Save your changes first." under it) and Remove
team, full width. Their questions (the template form,
Remove the Docs team…?) open here, in place, not in
the footer. Discard's question still takes the footer
over while it is asked. Desktop keeps them in the footer.
One column of cards (the grid's sm breakpoint, as
today). The two actions sit side by side, 36px tall
(over the 24px minimum); under 300px of card they
wrap under each other. Delete template is a 28px
quiet button at the card's top right.
Chips wrap, long names truncate, prompt lines wrap;
must hold at 390px and at 320px (400% zoom, 1.4.10).
Shown on the Agents page and on New task.
Cancel · Save changes: after This team
7 · Short viewports: the header and footer scroll with the body
Below about 500px of height (400% zoom at 1280 by 1024 is 320 by 256, a phone held sideways, or the on-screen keyboard
open) the header and the footer stop sticking: the whole panel is one scroller and the footer comes last, after This
team. The field in focus then has the whole viewport (1.4.10 Reflow, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured). A media query on the
viewport height decides it (max-height: 500px), not a guess about the keyboard. Above it the rule in note 2 holds.
The dashed box marks where the footer is: below, in the flow, reached by scrolling.
